# Kryntar

Kryntar Divers: 2,222 pixel diver NFTs on BNB Chain (chainId 56), plus the
Deep Dive game and the $KRYN token. The mint and the $KRYN claim are live.

Web: https://kryntar.xyz

## Contracts (BNB Chain, chainId 56)

- NFT (Kryntar Divers): 0xB77D3495d3ed4427dA78c9D0f7Cb76C21c23D9fe
- Token ($KRYN): 0x651a15460F62dF9d9B77ea0324fc948F6b94b5fA
- Claim (KrynClaim): 0xF423486D0B021E457c0132b3144728DEa105f028

## Mint lanes (all open)

- Surface Claim: mintFree(), 0 BNB, max 1 per wallet. Requires a Binance
  Agent ID in the wallet (registry
  0x60B9262456dE011F7d15a54CdD8c48bAaa8B022F).
- Deep Forge: mintDeep(), 0.0005 BNB, max 5 per wallet.
- Legendary Mint: mintLegendary(), 0.01 BNB, max 5 per wallet, guaranteed
  Legendary.

## Claim

- claim(tokenId): 25,000 $KRYN per Diver, once per token ID, current holder
  only, fee exactly 0.0001 BNB.

## Agent prompts

Each prompt is 4 lines: direct execute, contract address + function + value
only. Replace <ID> with the Diver number in the claim prompt.

Mint (free):

Mint 1 Kryntar Diver on BNB Chain (chainId 56). Contract: 0xB77D3495d3ed4427dA78c9D0f7Cb76C21c23D9fe.
Check mintOpen() is true and this wallet holds a Binance Agent ID. If the mint is closed or there is no Agent ID, STOP and report to me.
Call mintFree() and pay exactly 0 wei.
Execute once, then send me the transaction hash.

Mint (Deep):

Mint 1 Kryntar Diver on BNB Chain (chainId 56). Contract: 0xB77D3495d3ed4427dA78c9D0f7Cb76C21c23D9fe.
Check mintOpen() is true. If the mint is closed, STOP and report to me.
Call mintDeep() and pay exactly 500000000000000 wei.
Execute once, then send me the transaction hash.

Mint (Legendary):

Mint 1 Kryntar Diver on BNB Chain (chainId 56). Contract: 0xB77D3495d3ed4427dA78c9D0f7Cb76C21c23D9fe.
Check mintOpen() is true. If the mint is closed, STOP and report to me.
Call mintLegendary() and pay exactly 10000000000000000 wei — guaranteed Legendary.
Execute once, then send me the transaction hash.

Claim:

Claim $KRYN for Diver #<ID> on BNB Chain (chainId 56). Claim contract: 0xF423486D0B021E457c0132b3144728DEa105f028.
Replace <ID> with the Diver number. Check claimed(<ID>) is false and this wallet holds Diver #<ID>. If already claimed or not held, STOP and report to me.
Call claim(<ID>) and pay exactly 100000000000000 wei.
Execute once, then send me the transaction hash.
